requirement: Describe a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel-group, multicenter exploratory study in adults with active moderate-to-severe ulcerative colitis.

evidence.text: The cover and synopsis define the randomized double-blind placebo-controlled parallel multicenter study.

notes: Do not describe this small exploratory study as a confirmatory Phase III trial.

requirement: Specify 2:1 randomization to bertilimumab 10 mg/kg or matching placebo, stratified by previous anti-TNF treatment, with Mayo and UCEIS centrally read blind to subject identity.

evidence.text: The protocol gives the allocation, treatment, stratification and central-reader blinding.

requirement: Describe three 30-minute IV infusions on Days 0, 14 and 28, followed by efficacy and safety assessments through Day 90, with the primary endpoint at Day 56.

evidence.text: The synopsis and schedule define dosing and follow-up visits.

requirement: Report a planned sample of up to 42 subjects selected for exploratory precision rather than a formally powered confirmatory hypothesis.

evidence.text: The protocol states up to 42 subjects and explains the precision-based exploratory rationale.

notes: Do not revive the superseded 105-evaluable-subject calculation from the amendment history.

requirement: Define Day-56 clinical response as at least a 3-point and 30% decrease from screening total Mayo score plus either at least a 1-point rectal-bleeding decrease or a rectal-bleeding subscore of 0 or 1.

evidence.text: The protocol gives the conjunctive clinical-response definition.
The SAP codes the same definition as success versus failure.

requirement: Include the Day-56 secondary endpoints: screening-to-Day-56 Mayo and UCEIS change, clinical remission, mucosal healing, and partial-Mayo change over follow-up.

evidence.text: The protocol lists the secondary efficacy endpoints.

requirement: Define clinical remission as total Mayo at most 2 with no individual subscore above 1, mucosal healing as endoscopy subscore 0 or 1, and improvement changes as screening minus post-screening score.
acceptable_values: remission total Mayo <=2 and each subscore <=1

evidence.text: The protocol defines remission and mucosal healing.
The SAP fixes the change direction, Mayo, partial-Mayo and UCEIS derivations, and last-pre-treatment baseline.

requirement: Use the final SAP mITT definition: randomized, at least one dose, complete screening Mayo and at least one post-baseline complete Mayo, excluding major entry violations determined by blinded review.
acceptable_values: at least one post-baseline complete Mayo

evidence.text: The final SAP narrows the protocol mITT definition to require a post-baseline complete Mayo score.

notes: This is a post-protocol operational decision and must not be a hidden protocol-only fact.

requirement: Define PP as an mITT subset without blinded-review major outcome-relevant violations, with at least two of three doses and complete screening and Visit-7 Mayo scores; use observed PP data without imputation.

evidence.text: The protocol defines the PP set and complete-case handling.
The SAP confirms the PP rule.

requirement: Use the final safety set of subjects exposed to study treatment and/or protocol-required prophylactic treatment, noting that prophylaxis records are unavailable for some subjects enrolled before protocol version 8.

evidence.text: The final SAP expands the safety set to relevant prophylactic exposure and documents the amendment-era data limitation.

notes: The protocol itself defines safety by study-treatment exposure only.

requirement: For missing Visit-7 complete Mayo and UCEIS in mITT, use the nearest post-screening early-discontinuation or unscheduled measure within plus or minus four weeks, carrying it forward or backward according to date; explore sensitivity analyses if missingness is non-trivial.

evidence.text: The final SAP replaces the protocol's MI branch with a nearest-value window rule and leaves sensitivity implementation conditional.

notes: This changed after Protocol Version 8 and is therefore confirmed_decisions only.

requirement: Analyze primary clinical response descriptively in mITT by treatment group using success/failure incidence and a 90% exact binomial confidence interval, with alpha 0.10 for exploratory between-group comparisons.

evidence.text: The final SAP identifies mITT, alpha 0.10 and 90% exact binomial intervals for the primary analysis.

notes: The SAP is ambiguous about a direct treatment-effect estimator and inferential test.

requirement: Repeat the primary summaries with 95% exact binomial intervals and in PP with both 90% and 95% intervals; summarize UCEIS, remission, mucosal healing and partial Mayo descriptively.

evidence.text: The SAP specifies the repeated confidence intervals, PP support and secondary summaries.

requirement: State that analyses are exploratory and no multiplicity adjustment is planned; do not present nominal alpha 0.10 findings as familywise-error-controlled confirmatory claims.

evidence.text: The protocol specifies exploratory testing at alpha 0.10 without multiplicity correction.

requirement: Summarize bertilimumab PK descriptively for Cmax, Tmax, Cavg, Cmin and half-life using predose, 30-minute, 4-hour and follow-up samples, with additional parameters only if supported by the sparse sampling.

evidence.text: The protocol defines sampling and descriptive PK parameters.

requirement: Summarize changes in fecal calprotectin, eosinophils, serum eotaxin-1, hs-CRP and ECP over time and biopsy eotaxin-1/eosinophils from screening to Day 56.

evidence.text: The protocol defines the pharmacodynamic endpoints and descriptive summaries.

requirement: Summarize TEAEs and SAEs by treatment, SOC and preferred term, worst severity and worst relatedness; also summarize infusion reactions, vital signs, laboratory values, physical examinations, ECGs and anti-bertilimumab antibodies through Day 90.

evidence.text: The protocol specifies the safety observation window and summaries.
The SAP provides the safety table structure.

requirement: Ask the statistical team to reconcile the protocol-versus-final-SAP changes to the mITT definition, safety-set prophylaxis rule and missing-data strategy before treating them as binding protocol-only choices.

evidence.text: Protocol Version 8 includes partial-Mayo eligibility and MI branches.
The final SAP changes those operational rules.

notes: The model should expose the discrepancies rather than silently choosing the later hidden plan.

requirement: Confirm the exact between-group estimator and test for clinical response, treatment attribution rules, handling of missing primary data outside the plus-or-minus-four-week window, threshold for non-trivial missingness, and executable sensitivity analyses.
acceptable_values: confirm out-of-window failure or missing rule

evidence.text: The SAP gives descriptive group intervals and a conditional sensitivity statement but does not fully specify these decisions.
